insight: The first commercial product from World Labs, Fei-Fei Li's spatial-AI lab that hit unicorn status months after its 2024 founding.
name: Marble
tagline: Generate editable 3D worlds from text, images, or video.
description: A generative world model from World Labs that turns text prompts, photos, videos, panoramas, or 3D layouts into editable, downloadable 3D environments. Outputs can be refined and exported for use in game engines and 3D pipelines.
edge: Outputs persistent, editable, downloadable 3D worlds for game engines — not on-the-fly video-only scenes.
pros: Exports to game engines and 3D pipelines
Inputs from text, photos, panoramas, or 3D
Cleaner geometry than prior world models
cons: Quality degrades away from start point
No memory of your style across runs
Occasional generation failures; limited free tier
